nodes.title: 🟨🔬 CLIP Sub-Block Tuner
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Surgical micro-tuning for individual layers and sub-components of the Qwen3 Text Encoder.
• Targets Attention projections (Q, K, V, Out, Q-Norm), SwiGLU MLP projections (Gate, Up, Down), and LayerNorms.

HOW TO USE:
1. Pick 'target_layer' (Layer_1 to Layer_7) and 'sub_layer' (A to F).
2. Adjust specific projection sliders (e.g. MLP_gate_proj, ATTN_q_proj).
3. Fine-tune semantic attention weights without affecting the rest of the text encoder.

nodes.title: 🟨🌪️ CLIP Sub-Block Chaos Tuner
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Stochastic perturbation engine for Qwen3 Text Encoder sub-layers.
• Injects controlled mathematical noise into semantic layers to unlock unexpected text associations and prompt interpretations.

HOW TO USE:
1. Select 'target_layer' and 'sub_layer'.
2. 'chaos_strength': Amplitude of perturbation (keep low, e.g. 0.05–0.15 for coherence).
3. Set probability chance sliders for target projections (e.g. ATTN_k_proj_chance).
4. Cycle 'seed' to generate diverse semantic interpretations.

nodes.title: 🟪🔮 LoRA Block Loader
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Loads standard LoRAs and applies block-level weight filtering across Krea-2 model blocks.
• Isolates or filters out LoRA influence from specific sections (e.g. keep style in Block_4–6 while removing face distortion from Block_1–2).

HOW TO USE:
1. Select your 'lora_name' and set overall 'strength_model' & 'strength_clip'.
2. Adjust block sliders (Block_1 to Block_6, Text_Fusion, Time_Embed):
   • 1.00 = Full LoRA strength in this block.
   • 0.00 = Zero LoRA influence (completely stripped from this block).

nodes.title: 🟪🔬 Load Sub-Block LoRA
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Surgical LoRA loader that applies sub-tensor component filtering within target blocks.
• Enables loading only Attention Q/K/V deltas or only MLP weights of a LoRA while zeroing out unwanted components.

HOW TO USE:
1. Choose 'lora_name', 'target_block', and 'sub_block'.
2. Set individual component multipliers (1.00 = full LoRA delta, 0.00 = disabled).
3. Ideal for isolating high-frequency details (Attention) from bulk semantic transformations (MLP).

nodes.title: 🟪🌪️ Load Sub-Block Chaos LoRA
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Stochastic LoRA loader that probabilistically filters LoRA weight tensors per sub-component.
• Blends LoRA weights randomly into the base model, creating unique hybridized styles and preventing overfitting artifacts.

HOW TO USE:
1. Choose 'lora_name', 'target_block', and 'sub_block'.
2. 'base_chance': Default probability threshold for all layers.
3. Component chance sliders: Override probability for specific sub-tensors (e.g. ATTN_wq_query_chance).
4. Change 'seed' to roll new LoRA patch combinations.

nodes.title: 🟦✨ Model Tuner
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Macro-level block group tuning for the Krea-2 diffusion transformer.
• Scales entire block groups (Block_1 to Block_6), Text_Fusion adapters, Time_Embed, and Projections.

HOW TO USE:
1. Mode: 'Soft Value' for subtle micro-tuning (10% dampening) or 'Real Value' for direct 1:1 scaling.
2. Sliders: 0.00 = baseline (1.0x). Positive values amplify feature depth; negative values attenuate.
3. Advanced: Paste comma-separated values in 'vectors_override' or JSON in 'granular_json'.

nodes.title: 🟦🔬 Model Sub-Block Tuner
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Surgical precision tuning for specific sub-tensor components within individual Krea-2 transformer blocks (Block_1A to Block_6D).
• Targets exact layers: Attention (Q, K, V, Out, Norms), SwiGLU MLP (Gate, Up, Down), Linear Time, and LayerNorms.

HOW TO USE:
1. Select 'target_block' (e.g. Block_1) and specific 'sub_block' (e.g. Block_1A).
2. Adjust component sliders (e.g. boost MLP_gate_swiglu or damp ATTN_wq_query).
3. Connect multiple Sub-Block Tuners in series to sculpt different blocks independently.

nodes.title: 🟦🌪️ Model Sub-Block Chaos Tuner
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Stochastic discovery engine that injects randomized perturbation deltas into specific sub-tensor components.
• Discovers novel aesthetic styles, texture dynamics, and architectural nuances.

HOW TO USE:
1. Set 'target_block' and 'sub_block' to target specific layers.
2. 'chaos_strength': Controls the amplitude of the random perturbation.
3. Component sliders (0.00 to 1.00): Set probability chance that each component receives a chaos delta.
4. 'seed': Change or randomize seed to roll different variations.

nodes.title: 🟦🟨🔄 Reset Patcher
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Creates a clean, isolated Model/CLIP patcher wrapper and strips away all previous patches/LoRAs.
• Ensures that downstream tuning nodes start from a fresh, pristine baseline.

HOW TO USE:
1. Connect directly after UNETLoader and CLIPLoader.
2. Toggle 'reset_model' / 'reset_clip' to True.
3. Pipe the clean MODEL/CLIP outputs into your first tuning or visualizer node.

nodes.title: 🟨✨ CLIP Tuner
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Macro-level weight scaling across the 36 layers of the Qwen3 / Qwen3-VL text encoder.
• Controls prompt adherence, semantic depth, and concept binding across early, middle, and late layers.

HOW TO USE:
1. Mode: 'Soft Value' (recommended for text stability) or 'Real Value'.
2. Sliders (Layer_1 to Layer_7 + Embedding):
   • Early layers (1-2): Syntax & low-level token embeddings.
   • Mid layers (3-5): Semantic relation & attribute binding.
   • Late layers (6-7): Complex concept synthesis & composition.
3. 0.00 = baseline (1.0x).
